description: Verify that Client Mode StopOfferService stops DUT FindService for the bounced Service+Instance
approach:
[Objective]
StopOfferService → client-mode must stop emitting FindService for that specific Service+Instance.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. DUT FindService observed in Start-Up.
3. Tester → DUT: StopOfferService.
4. Observation: NO further DUT FindService for that S+I.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT followed client-mode FindService rule — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_findservice: No DUT FindService during start phase
